title: Fiscal Re-Acceleration
summary: Fiscal momentum, bank resilience and DeFi risk.
assessment: The fiscal reacceleration call has a measurable success, and the FIMA explanation correctly identifies a funding backstop. The jet-fuel denominator is wrong. DeFi emergency control validates a centralization concern, while Lido’s falling market share challenges a simple winner-take-all story. Bank results are constructive but mixed across securities.

claims.claim: DeFi remains below its 2021 TVL peak.
claims.reason: The standard all-chain DefiLlama series supports the comparison. Excluding liquid staking and double-counted TVL, the 2021 maximum was $177.46bn on November 9; the highest subsequent observation through April 26, 2026 was $167.91bn on October 7, 2025.
